batting.name: S Dhawan
batting.dismissal: c VR Iyer b LH Ferguson

batting.name: SO Hetmyer
batting.dismissal: c TG Southee b VR Iyer

batting.name: AR Patel
batting.dismissal: c LH Ferguson b VR Iyer

batting.name: R Ashwin
batting.dismissal: c N Rana b TG Southee

batting.name: Shubman Gill
batting.dismissal: c SS Iyer b K Rabada

batting.name: RA Tripathi
batting.dismissal: c SPD Smith b Avesh Khan

batting.name: EJG Morgan
batting.dismissal: c Lalit Yadav b R Ashwin

batting.name: SP Narine
batting.dismissal: c AR Patel b A Nortje

balls.text: bullseye! Glove off as Rabada misses the slog off this full ball outside off. Rabada-Avesh try to pinch a bye, but DK grabs the ball, takes aim, and knocks the stumps down. Capitals finish on 127 for 9
good length, on off. Muscled to deep midwicket

free runs! Second time in two overs. Full toss on off. Avesh goes for the leg-side slog. Gill at deep midwicket is there, but the ball pops out of his hands while taking a side-on catch. Hits the floor, and then rolls away to the boundary. He should feel lucky that did not go for a six. But spare a thought for Southee.
slower ball. Back of a length outside off. Loppy ounce. Misses the swing. Goes under the bat to the keeper

full just outside off. Comes down the track and muscles it to long on. But Pant is coming for the second, where there isn't any. Pant struggling to get back for his second, and Karun Nair - another sub fielder - throws it at the right end. Karthik collects, and breaks the stumps. The dive does not save Pant today

yorker length, just outside leg. But Pant skips out of the ball's line very late. Wide run collected. Southee not happy since that would've hit Pant's boot if he hadn't skipped away. A tad unlucky, Southee

back of a length slower all. Ashwin dances down the track and tries to pull. Up in the air, and taken at deep backward square. Words exchanged between Southee and Ashwin and now between Ashwin and Morgan! Karthik gets in between Morgan and Ashwin, and sends him back. Are they chatting about that extra run that Capitals took when the ball hit Pant's arm? Some people don't consider it as "fair play", which is a slippery slope anyway.

pinpoint yorker on off. But he digs it away to point. Fielder at point takes a shy at the bowler's end where Pant is in. But the ball hits him and rolls away. Allows them to take the second. But indirectly that's good for KKR since Ashwin is now on strike. Otherwise it would've been Pant

yorker length on leg stump. Mistimed to deep midwicket, and it can be a run out if Iyer can grab the throw from the deep well. But the awkward bounce off the side pitches makes Iyer fumble. Allows Ashwin to complete the second
full toss just outside off. Strikes one sweetly over the non-striker's head. But lands short of Cutting at long on, who does not attack the ball
yorker length on off. Whipped off his toe stp deep midwicket. Pant wanted two, but there's none of it. Ashwin takes strike
yorker length just outside off stump. Dug away to the off side

ben Cutting misfields and that's four to the total. Full toss, wide outside off from around the stumps. Struck down the ground, but Cutting had gotten behind the ball. However it bursts through his hands and goes for four
good length, on middle. Swipes one to deep midwicket off the back foot. Tripathi there
fullish on off stump. Pant stays on the back foot and smacks an inside-out flat batted shot that finds the gap at long off! Between the two fielders at long off and deep extra cover
good length, on middle. Backs away and punches it to deep extra cover
slower ball yorker. Almost perfect. Lands around leg stump, and Pant digs it away for just one
slower ball. Full on off but the cutter angles past off stump. Pant tumbles over trying to play a reverse sweep. Through to DK
good length, on middle. Slower ball too. Worked to square leg

good length on off. Turning away. Pant looks to cut, but the ball goes under his bat to Karthik. Karthik appeals for caught behind and Chakravarthy follows his Tamil Nadu senior. Umpire says no, and they've gone for the review. TV umpire says "very close to the bat, give me the UltraEdge." But the technology shows that Pant's bat is nowhere near the ball. Dot to end Chakravarthy's spell, and Knight Riders lose a review too
good length just outside off. Turning into middle. Punched to long on
full on off. Reverse sweep payed to deep point. Protection there though
full on middle, and angling into leg. Looks to flick, misses. Hits the pad and rolls away to short fine leg. Team hundred
full on off. Comes down the track and looks to hit a big shot to the long on region. Edged to short third man instead

what's happened here! DK and Pant share a smile after that. Pant looks to drive through the off side. But its bottom edged onto the deck and bounces up. Might hit the stumps so Pant tries to swat the ball away with the bat. But the bat nearly hits DK on his helmet! DK takes a tumble in anticipation and replays show that was very close
over the stumps. Length ball just outside off. Ashwin uses the width to play a cut that goes very fine past short third man!
full outside off. Toe-ends a drive to long on for a single
full outside off, and he pushes a drive to deep extra cover for one
full on middle and leg. Clipped but Lockie Ferguson at midwicket dives to his left to take a sharp catch! It's a low catch infact, and Iyer now has two!
full and wide outside off. No shot offered and that's because Axar knew it was beyond the wide tramlines
good length ball just around off. Goes to Axar on the fifth-stump line. Can't free his arms. Punched back to Iyer with the full face of the bat
full outside leg stump. Slower ball too. Rolls away to DK
around the stumps. Full around off stump. Swept behind square for one
good length on off. Jagging in sharply this time. Punched to cover. Narine concedes just 1, and ends his spell with 2 for 18
fullish outside off. Turning away and he bunts a shot towards point
full on middle, and worked off his pads to midwicket

Narine knows that's gone! wrong'un one ball, offbreak next, and Yadav is gone. Full on off stump. Yadav presses forward to nudge it leg side. But the ball turns in, hits him in front of middle, and Narine raises his hand even before he turned around to appeal. Yadav out for duck, Narine gets his second.
over the stumps. Full outside off. Yadav presses forward to defend. Turns away, and whizzes past the outside edge. Lovely
around the stumps. Full just outside off. Mistimed slog sweep along the ground to deep midwicket
fullish just outside off. Defended gently back to the bowler. Excellent Iyer over. Time out
holes out and Iyer gets an important wicket. Wide-ish outside off, but not as full as Hetmyer would've wanted. Looks to go over the top, but doesn't have the perfect connection. Straight to long off
attempts the yorker. Ends up as a low full toss angling into middle and off. Swiped to midwicket, where there's a gap. Iyer runs around there to stop a second run
full outside leg stump. Slower ball, and worked off the boot to deep square leg for another one
full outside off. Pant walks down the track and slogs to the leg side. Mistimed through midwicket, and deep midwicket runs in to stop the second
fullish outside off from around the stumps. Pant throws his bat at a slapped drive, and it goes over cover. Ball slowly rolls away to the boundary
just four off the over, plus a wicket. Overpitched wide outside off. Slapped to deep point
length ball with width on offer. Waits for it, and plays a late cut to third man for a single
full outside off from around the stumps now. Caresses a drive but can't beat the fielder at cover
back of a length outside off and angling further away. Sticks the bat out and runs it past point's right to third man. Warrier doing the running about in the deep

wild heave, and pays the price! The slower ball is out, the 143kph delivery is next. Good length outside off but angling into the stumps. Smith looks to clobber one over midwicket, but bottom-edged onto the stumps

Smith walks across to the off side to play a premeditated scoop to the leg side. But Ferguson attempts the dipping slower ball wide outside off. That means the ball is close to Smith, and he looks to scoop, but inside-edged onto his groin region. Gets up after a short delay
overpitched on off, and clipped off his boot to deep midwicket
full on leg stump. Looks to flick it fine but misses. Hits the pad, and rolls away to the leg side
slower ball. Full and wide from over the stumps. Checks a driven shot to extra cover on the boundary line
yorker length outside off stump. Dug away to cover. Pant wants one, but none available
full around the stumps again, Iyer. Slices a drive from near his toes to Rana at point
full on leg stump, and whipped to Narine at square leg. Narine does not notice that Smith has come halfway down the track. Slow to release
good length outside off. Tucked off his waist to the gap at midwicket. Narine has to run around to cut the second run
full just outside off stump. Worked off the pads to midwicket's right. They consider taking two, but opt for one
around the stumps. Length ball outside off and angling in. Punches off the back foot to wide long on for a single
over the stumps. Good length just outside off, and worked off his pads to square leg for a single
super Smith! Full around leg stump from Narine, and Smith sweeps behind square beautifully. Easy boundary
good length outside off from around the stumps. Angling into off. Punched down the ground
fuller and outside off. Pushed to point with the open face of the bat
short of a length and wide of off. Cuts that powerfully to deep point
pretty full on off, and clipped to the left of long-on. Pretty rapid running means they can gobble two
very full on off, and clipped across to deep square leg
cut away to deep point! Shorter in length and wide of off, as Smith makes room to slam that away with the open face of the bat. Beats the man in the deep to his left
tickles this behind! Good length ball on middle and leg, and Smith flicks that behind the wicket, as short fine leg dives to his left, but is beaten
makes room to flash, but is beaten. Full ball and wide of off, and turning into him. Pant cuts that away from his body, but doesn't connect
fuller ball on off, and flicked to deep square leg for another single
comes down to this full ball on off, which is turning into him. But it strikes Smith's pads, as he looks to tap that
looks to sweep this full ball wide of off, and goes down on his knee as well. But mistimes that toward deep midwicket, as his bottom hand comes off
good length ball again, and just outside off. Good bounce, and with no turn. Pushed to deep midwicket to bring up the team's fifty. Smith wanted a second, but was sent back
good length ball outside off, with a hint of turn into him. Clipped to deep midwicket, and they complete hurried two
and now Smith does the same. Seeps that to deep midwicket after going down on his back knee, as this is bowled full on off
goes down on his back knee to slog-sweep that full ball on off to long-on. That was hit pretty powerfully
fullish ball on middle, with a hint of turn away from him. Clipped to the left of short fine leg
full-toss on leg, as Pant closes the bat face to drive that to long-on
fullish on middle, and turning into Smith. Flicked to long leg to beat short fine leg inside the circle
full and straight on off at 96jph. Tapped to cover off the front foot
and again. This is fuller and  just outside off. Not great bounce there, as Pant pushes it back to the bowler
good length ball and slightly wide of off. Pant jabs back at that
good length ball with some bounce on off. Smith clips that to deep midwicket off the back foot
turns in again! Good length ball on off, and spinning into the left-hander, as Pant pushes at that toward cover from deep in his crease

sharp turn and drift, and cleaned him up! A classical offspinner's wicket this one. Pitches just outside off and turns back in nicely to hit the off stump, as Iyer is undecided to play off the front or the back foot, and so remains rooted in his crease pretty much. The ball sneaks in between bat and pad, and bang!
full and just outside off. Again he drives that back to long-on
full and wide-ish of off. Slashed to cover-point with a horizontal bat
short of a length on middle, and driven to deep midwicket with the full face of the bat
fuller again on off, but this is driven between point and cover
full and straight again on off. Blocked back off the front foot
pretty full and just outside off. Jammed to the man at cover
shortish and pitching outside leg. Keeps angling down for a wide
full ball on off, with a hint of turn into him. Pushed to deep midwicket

slashed to cover-point! It was similar to the previous ball, in that it is short and wide of off. Dhawan looks to play that on the up, like he had in the last ball, but this time lobs that right to the fielder, who is on the edge of the circle. Knight Riders strike early, as Capitals lose their in-form batter
goes for the flash, but is beaten by the extra bounce. Ferguson bowls shortish and wide of off, as Dhawan looks to loft that, but can't connect as the ball passes over his bat
slower ball on a fullish length and wide of off. Cuts that away from hos body to the man at cover-point
fuller on middle and leg, and turned away to fine leg to keep rotating the strike
whips that over midwicket! Right in the arc for Smith, as Ferguson goes full and just outside off. Smith clears his front lag, and whacks that over
goes pretty full and a touch wide of off. Looks to heave that, but gets it off the inside half of the bat toward midwicket
skips down again, as Southee bowls on a good length and just outside off. Cut away to deep point after waiting for the ball to come

Southee appeals for leg before, but not given. And Morgan reviews at the last moment. Pitches on a good length on off, and angles into him, as it keeps low after Southee bowls with change of pace. Dhawan misses his clip, with the ball striking his front pad around middle, with his front leg in the air. Some wait for UltraEdge here, and hence the delay. And finally it is confirmed that there is no edge there. Replays show that is umpire's call on middle, and so remains not out. Knight Riders retain their review.
crashed through the covers! Cover-point dives to his left, but in vain. Dhawan dances down to this full ball on off, and presents the flat bat to ram that all along the ground
flicked to deep square leg. This is pretty full on middle and off, as Smith shuffles across to whip that
slower ball on a shortish length and a little wide of off. Cuts this to deep point from deep in the crease
goes to slash, but doesn't get bat on ball! Good length ball on off, and angling into him. That was too close to cut, and was beaten there

and again! This was full, and slightly wide of off. Smith fends at that to drive through the covers, but the ball passes between his bat and pad, as his bottom hand also comes off as he leans into the drive
swing and a miss! Smith looks to deposit the length ball wide of off over the bowler's head, but is beaten
good length and just outside off. He takes a step down, and punches that to deep point, which is straightish
hoicked to long leg this time! Another ball that is too full on off, allowing Dhawan a free swing of the arms to dispatch that for four more

flicked to deep midwicket all along the ground! Again makes good use of his wrists, as the bowler goes really full on off, and getting it to angle into his pads. Just clipped with the closed face of the bat
goes on a good length and outside off. Clipped to deep square leg across the line
full again, and straighter on off. Blocked toward cover off the front foot
mid-off tumbles to his right to stop this drive, as Dhawan skips down to this full ball on off
outside edge, and four to third man! That was in the driving length in the channel outside off. There is no slip there, as the edge finds the gap between the keeper and short third man
goes a touch wider of the crease to bowl pretty full and just outside off. Smith taps this to cover, and they set off for  quick single
full again, but angling into off. Pushed to the man at midwicket
full delivery on middle and leg, as he flicks that to the right of mid-on from across off stump. He almost exposed his middle and leg stump there
full and straightish on middle. Clipped to mid-on with a shuffle, as Smith wants a run but is sent back
full-toss on his pads, and clipped to long leg! Uses his wrists to beat short fine leg to his right, and also the man at deep square leg running to his left
much fuller and straighter on middle. Pushed back to the bowler with the closed face of the bat
fuller in length, and just outside off. Dhawan looks to cut close to his body, but gets it off the bottom half of the bat toward slip
good length ball outside leg, and angling away. Takes Dhawan's pad to trickle to the on side as he tries to flick
bowls that really full on his pads, as Smith flicks that to deep square leg after stepping across off as usual
Rabada flies, but can't get a hand to it! Length ball outside off, and Rana has cut this past the third-man fielder on the boundary! Knight Riders win by three wickets
good length on middle. And he nudges to the leg side. Ferguson hobbles his way out half-way down, but Rana sends him back. Ferguson is slow to get back and Axar nearly had him run out!

twist in the tale? Avesh Khan gets his 50th T20 wicket in style. Fullish outside off. Angling into the stumps. Southee goes for the glory shot with a leg-side slog, but he gets the inside edge instead. Off stump rattled
full on off. Pushed to mid off and another quick single taken. The batters know that the pressure is on the fielders
full outside off. Skips down the ground and drills a shot to Rabada at mid off. Southee is off for one, and he will be out only if there's a direct-hit

high, in the air, but lands safe! Back of a length outside off stump. Looks to pull over the leg side, but the drag goes up in the air instead. Deep midwicket and fine leg come together to get under it, but it falls between both players
good length outside off. Tries to punch it through the off side but mistimed to midwicket instead
full ball angling into middle stump. Tapped off the back foot to midwicket, but no single
back of a length ball on middle and off. Lets it go through to the keeper
slices it to the off side. Back of a length ball. Angling away. Looks to club it over the leg side but the bat's face turns in his hand. Pops up for Axar at cover
good length just outside off stump. Looks to guide one to third man but misses
slower ball, but too full and more importantly too wide. On the bounce to Pant
full toss, nearly waist-high. Around middle stump, and whipped to square leg for a single
slower ball, good length wider outside off. Tries to cut, misses
overpitched, lands just outside off but beyond the stumps. Narine can't get bat on all
good length, outside off. Flat-batted to cover's left. 21 off the over

smacked! Narine is now toying with Rabada. He goes for a length ball outside leg stump, and Narine swings it leg side like a baseball player. Swung off the bat's sweet spot...and six over deep midwicket!
that's been tonked! Rabada bowling gentle offcutters. Length ball on leg stump and Narine turns to the leg side before shoveling a shot through deep midwicket. One-bounce four

top edged for six! Short ball on leg stump. Narine swivels to pull over square leg. But it takes the edge, flies over short fine leg, and goes for half a dozen. Extra pace is a double-edged sword in Sharjah
over Rabada's head! But doesn't have the best connection. Knee-high full toss on off and thumped back past. Long off and long on both come together to stop the four
full and wide outside off. Presses forward and toe-ends a drive through cover. He misfields, and Smith at mid off runs around to intercept. Front-foot no ball though
back of a length on leg stump. slower ball. Rana meets it with soft hands while pressing forward
full and wide. Stretches forward and driven to cover
back of a length on leg. Rising ball. Nudged from near his chest to third man

chops on the slower ball! Another wicket from this end that comes after a series of dot balls. Good length ball, just outside off. Karthik first shuffles towards leg stump before coming back to his usual position. Tries to run it down to third man, ends up getting the inside edge onto his stumps. DK out for 12.
yorker attempted, yorker executed. Aimed at the base of middle stump. Dug back to Avesh
back of a length outside off. Wants to roll his wrists to flick one through midwicket but the ball goes under the bat. Through to Pant
nearly chopped on! Length ball outside off. Angling in, tries to defend. Bottom-edged onto the pitch and it very nearly goes onto the stumps
half-tracker on off, and turning into DK. He swivels and flicks to deep backward square for a single. 20 off the over!
slashed and slashed hard! Full and wide. DK bends his knees to cut through point. Thick edge, past Pant's gloves, and its gone to third man for four!
continues with the around the wicket line. Length ball angling into leg. Clipped off the back foot to deep square leg
twelve in two! This is classier. Full on off. He goes down on one knee and swipes it over cow corner for a six. Lands just near the fans in the second tier of the stand

dances down the track! And that will help the KKR camp breathe a sigh of relief. Full just outside off. He skips down, and smacks it over Lalit's head. For one small moment it seemed like that would be caught out, but then it struck that this is Sharjah
around the stumps. Fullish outside off. Cut behind square and gets the third man-point gap. But fielder in the deep runs around to stop the four. Outfield slow again
good length outside off. Stands tall and punches to cover
good length outside off stump. Looks to nudge one fine to third man, but makes no copnnection
length ball wide outside off. Looks to slap a cut but gets a thick edge along the ground through the vacant slip cordon. Important runs
beautiful cover drive but the outfield is slow. Smith at midd off has the legs to run to the boundary and cut it off. Full, outside off, and DK met the ball from right under his eyes
yorker length, on off stump. Dug away, with careful hands
good length on leg stump, and clipped off his waist to deep square leg. Fine leg has to run around to intercept
full just outside off stump. Another big stride forward. Defended. Ashwin ends with 1/24
full just outside off stump. Nudged off his toes to midwicket. No run
flighted full on middle stump. Driven past the bowler to long off for a single
full and wide outside off. Tapped to cover point off the front foot, and DK calls early for the single
Ashwin gives Morgan a sendoff! As expected. Good length outside off. Looks to punch off the back foot, but it turns away, takes the outside edge, and gobbled up by first slip!
fullish, outside off. Ball stays low. Mistimed to point

back of a length outside off. Gill skips down the ground and looks to break the shackles. Flat-batted straight back, but the slower ball means Gill is through the shot too early. Mistimed, and long on makes no mistake. Wicket maiden!
good length outside off. Tentatively cut square, but finds point again
yorker attempted again. Nearly perfect. Gill brings the bat out to dig it away
full on off stump. Nudges it off his pads to midwicket. No run though
fullish, outside off, and driven to cover
good length outside off. Sticks the bat out and nudges it to point
fuller ball on off, and he opens the bat face to point
short of a length and wide of off, and he cuts that to deep point's right for two more
full ball on off, and dabbed toward short third man
looks to reverse, but misses this full ball on off
good length ball and wide of off, as the ball flies off Rana's top edge. Hit hard enough for the ball to go over both point and and short third man for a couple
pretty full ball in the driving length outside off, and drilled to deep point

sweeps this to fine leg to just beat the fielder! Fine leg runs to his left, but can't get a hand. Ashwin bowls full on his pads again, as he slogs that to first beat short fine leg to his right and the man in the deep running in
bowls this from wider of the crease to go on a good length on middle. Clipped to deep square leg
fuller ball on middle, and clipped to deep midwicket
again Gill makes room and skips down a step to drive that full ball on off to long-off
laps that full ball on leg to fine leg, as he goes low and almost falls over to the off side
looks to reverse-sweep this tossed up ball on leg, but is beaten as he plays too early and the ball is pretty slow as well
reverse-seeps this full on off, but finds the man at point for another dot
chipped to cover aerially! Another full ball on off, and just pushed back in the air
full ball on off, and pushed to cover
closes the bat face to this full ball on off, which is turning in. Clipped toward deep square leg
pretty full and just outside off. Defended to midwicket after coming forward
good length ball on off, and keeps a touch low. Tapped to point
full ball on middle, and he closes the bat face to clip that to square leg
pretty full on middle and leg, and driven back off the leading edge

Smith flies, and stretches his right hand out, as the ball tickles his fingers and goes for six. Gill swept that hard off a full length on off by going down on his back knee. At first it seemed it was hit far enough, but had good height too eventually
short of a length ball outside off, and turning into him. Cut to point after letting it to turn
jabbed back to the bowler, as Ashwin goes full on off
tossed up and very full on off. Pushed to long-on off the inside half of the bat
fullish ball on his pads, and clipped behind to short fine leg, who dives to his left to stop that
chipped to Smith at mid-off! Smith runs across a few steps to his left to take that over his head. Change of pace by Avesh, as he presented the full face of the bat
down the track, and hoicked to deep midwicket. This time the man is out on the boundary there. Avesh goes back of a length on off, as Gill whips that across the line again
crunches that drive to deep point. This is full and in the length outside off, as he presents the full face of the bat to drive that
yorker length on off, as Gill comes down again to drive that to cover. Tripathi is sent back by Gill after that shot
and Gill heaves that across the line to deep midwicket! Again shimmies down to a good length ball on off, and swings his bat to use his bottom hand to dispatch that on the bounce
another good length ball on middle, and clipped to deep midwicket. Three fielders run to give the chase, but still Gill convinces his partner to get the second
good length ball just outside off, as he dabs that late to short third man. He wanted a single, but there was no scope there
pitches that short on off, and Tripathi hammers that pull over deep square leg! Long hop to the new batter, and despite the turn into the batter, Tripathi creams that to start with a six first ball

bowled him! That was on a good length on middle and off, and bowled at 98kph too. Iyer misses his flick, as the ball stays relatively low too to crash into middle and off. Capitals sniff one out early, as Knight Riders' in-form opener is gone
bowls much fuller on off, as Gill pushes that to long-on from across off
goes to pull this short and wide-ish ball outside off, but gets it off the bottom edge behind the wicket. His cap comes off as he swivels to play that
dances down, as Axar bowls a yorker length ball on middle. Drills that to mid-off for a quick single
another pretty full on off, and driven to long-off again
pretty full and right on off. Driven back to the bowler with the full face of the bat
pulls his length back to on a good length on off. The ball turns into him, as Iyer pulls to deep square leg
looks to sweep this very full ball outside off, but is beaten, as the ball strikes his back pad after he goes down on his knee
hints to come down, but eventually pushes this full ball outside off to long-off
again goes to reverse, and again misses out. That is too full and outside off to play that, as the ball strikes his pad
fuller on middle, and he clips that to deep midwicket after skipping down. Beats Axar at midwicket to his left
good length on middle and leg, angling down leg. Wide called
looks to reverse-sweep this full ball on off, but is beaten, as the ball turns away from and hits Pant, who doesn't take it cleanly
comes down to this full ball outside off, and punches that top mid-off's left
shuffles across for a second, before lobbing that full ball on middle to long-off. That was far to Ashwin's right
full delivery on off, and he closes the bat face to clip that to deep midwicket
good length ball on off, and pushed forward to mid-off
good length on middle, and clipped to midwicket for a single this time
similar to the last ball. Another full ball on off, and finds cover again
full delivery just outside off, and pushed toward cover
crashed over the bowler's head! Gill comes down the track to this full ball on middle, and swings his bat to send the miles into the stands
full and straight on middle. Driven back to the bowler
beaten by the change of pace. Comes down and makes room to this good length ball on middle, but misses his slog. The ball goes over the stumps, and on the bounce to Pant
pulls to deep square leg now! Nortje goes short of a length on middle, as this time he plays square to pull in the gap available
this time finds the gap between cover and mid-off! Stands deep in his crease to this full ball on off, and punches that full stretch after leaning into the drive
in the driving length on off, and he presents the full face of the bat to crunch that to the man at cover
bowls on a fullish length on off, as Iyer drives that to mid-off with the bat turning in his hands
good length ball just outside off, and he clips that to the right of mid-on and sets off in a flash
